svg.text: Illustrative 5-port node (connectivityIn = connectivityOut = 5) — canonical ports Local · West · East · North · South;
a corner/edge Mesh node simply omits the ports it doesn't have. virtualChannels = 2. See the companion 3-port (Ring) diagram for the same structure at smaller scale.
bold colored paths = 5 example concurrently-granted wormhole-locked routes: West·vc0→Local, Local·vc0→East, East·vc1→South, South·vc0→North, North·vc1→West
vc tag — this step is outside RouterNode itself.
Local·vc0 → Local-out: a locally-addressed packet loops back to local delivery
StreamDemux — splits the physical link into vc lanes (skipped when a port has only 1 lane)
StreamFifo(depth=vcDepth) — per-VC buffering, one per lane
FlitRouter — holds resolved dest port until last flit (registered)
VirtualIdAllocator — one GrantTableCrossbar per output port
OutputPort — StreamArbiter merges 2 granted VC streams onto one physical link
bold = a granted path (this example set); faint = other reachable candidates, not currently granted

Line/label color identifies the origin port, carried through every stage of that port's granted path. Candidate lines never target their own canonical port (no U-turns) — except Local, which may target Local (self-delivery).
